premises.text: High-inflation emerging-market populations are largely unbanked without credit access for online shopping
premises.evidence_span: most of the population in this country is unbanked and also doesn't have access to credit

premises.text: Emerging-market online commerce share is far below the US partly due to missing online credit
premises.evidence_span: share of online commerce in the US is more than 10%, but across emerging markets is average on 2%

premises.text: Ripio Credit lets users buy on installments in local currency at Bitcoin-accepting merchants worldwide
premises.evidence_span: pay online on installments in local currency in any of our merchants or the hundreds of thousands of merchants that accept Bitcoin payments worldwide

premises.text: Identity photos, social/external data, ML, and fraud systems produce a score to approve credit
premises.evidence_span: it's also processed by our fraud prevention system. With all this information, we build a score

premises.text: Years of prior LatAm credit underwriting experience let the team approve credit for these users
premises.evidence_span: our team has been working on this problem for several years before BitPagos

premises.text: Underbanked repay via phone statements using bank transfer or cash at partnered Pago Fácil/Boleto/Oxxo locations
premises.evidence_span: in Argentina with Pago Fácil, in Brazil with Boleto Bancario, in Mexico in many stores like Oxxo or 7-Eleven

domains.name: Installment Bitcoin payments and cash collection

value.text: Enable unbanked emerging-market consumers to shop online on affordable local-currency credit installments
value.evidence_span: pay on credit on affordable installments in local currency

approve this credit to our user and being able to start paying online
pay on credit on affordable installments in local currency

notes: Anti-template note: three domains map to problem, underwriting, and payment/collection modules that are separately revisable in the pitch (not a forced need/product/money triad). Soft count 6; merchant-network traction merged into P3.
